provenance.notes: Zone A pilot (R5-01.S3): the sprite of the roster enemy SKEET (its interim slot is enemies/drifter, the v1 name). The two 18x18 frames of the flap loop are the top-row cells of the owner-picked SKEET animation sheet (hatches closed, hatches cracking open), cropped from the committed winner with a 6-px key border; the open-hatches cell that carries a released bullet orb and the damaged cell stay unused (the orb is procedural, the damage is hit-state art). The design carries its own 1-px near-black navy outline, so the outline pass is off. The palette is fixed to the sheet's fifteen design colours: an adaptive sixteen admits three key-blend rim pixels as a yellow-green, so the fixed list keeps the cap clear and sends the rim to its nearest design colour.
